# Support

No SLA — issues are welcome and answered on a best-effort basis, usually within a week.

- Bugs and feature requests: [open an issue](https://github.com/MubitLabs/mubit-engineering-control/issues) —
  bug reports attach the `mec doctor` bundle (redacted by construction).
- Security vulnerabilities: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — private reporting, never a public issue.
- What is proven, what runs on fakes, what is absent: [`docs/STATUS.md`](../docs/STATUS.md) and
  [`docs/known-limits.md`](../docs/known-limits.md).
